abstract: A kernel-checked chirality package for the Padovan substitution (0 ↦ 1, 1 ↦ 2, 2 ↦ 01 on Fin 3; its incidence matrix has characteristic polynomial x³ − x − 1, an orientation fact that is not used or compared). Three compared theorems, all at the iterate-factor level — they quantify over factors of the concrete words S^[n] [x], never over an abstract subshift. (1) The successor invariant: in every positive iterate from any seed, the letter 0 ("a") is immediately followed by 1 ("b"). (2) Chirality: the word 20 ("ca") is a factor of an iterate while its reversal 02 ("ac") is a factor of no iterate from any seed — the factor language reads differently backwards — proved from the invariant, with no enumeration on the ac side. (3) No palindromic factor: no factor of length ≥ 4 of any iterate from any seed (including the zeroth iterate) is a palindrome, via a complete length-≤5 window certificate for the seed a together with the index shift S [0] = [1], S [1] = [2], which exhibits every seed's iterate as a seed-a iterate. These are the three compared statements of the registered record (PALOMAR-2026-08-19-000006 at revision c48eb12), unchanged in this revision. The uniqueness results proved in this repository (Supplement.lean: padovan_minimal_unique, padovan_eigenvalue_unique, padovan_matrix_unique, pisot_ge_plastic, padovan_rules_chiral) are registered separately as PALOMAR-2026-10-18-000019 (stalex444/arithmetic-of-time-slowest-clock, revision 49eafbab4af8899b2a66469697bf74683a88ce87), which compares them over s, mir, inc and sub. Everything else in this repository is public and kernel-checked but not compared: among it the exact orientation threshold (padovan_exact_orientation_threshold_four), the irrationality of the distinguished slope (Time.beta_irrational), mirror identities for arbitrary substitutions, a rate identity, and the characteristic polynomial and chirality of a twelve-letter substitution for ρQ.

related_formalizations.note: PROOF-MODULE REUSE, NOT COMPARED CONTENT. The minimal Mahler measures in degrees 2 and 3 (quadratic_mahler_min', cubic_mahler_min') are the engine of the module theorem pisot_ge_plastic and hence of the bound in padovan_minimal_unique (Supplement.lean, not compared here). The five modules PdtMahler, PdtMahlerBox, PdtMahlerMain, PdtMahlerTheta and PdtMahlerWindow are that revision's files with every statement and proof unchanged: PdtMahlerBox differs from it only in the module-system header; the other four differ in the header and in docstrings (module docstrings, and in PdtMahlerMain the docstring of quartic_mahler_min), from which internal cross-references of the author's working notes were removed. None of that entry's statements is re-compared here.

CONTEXT. That entry's compared statements concern the infinite Padovan prefix path, its arithmetic record windows and a chiral timelike history in the quartic trace geometry, and it draws on the version-1 repository of this entry. No statement of it is re-compared here; the supporting modules here on trace forms and record windows (PdtSignature, PdtTraceLink, PdtRecordBoundary and others) serve the companion paper and are not compared.
